notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
• read all instructions, questions and texts very carefully
• answer comprehension questions with brief but focused answers – where only a single line space is
provided, short answers are expected
• make sure that they have answered every part of every question, including multiple choice
• make any alterations to answers clear
• allow themselves time to check their work, particularly spellings, verb agreements, and words copied
from the text.
notes.general_comments:
In general, candidates seemed to have enough time to complete the paper and most attempted an answer to
all questions. They were well prepared and although one style of exercise was less familiar, the majority of
candidates made a good attempt at it.
Standards of legibility and presentation were generally good, but copying of words from the text was less so.
Any time left after finishing the paper could be profitably spent checking that all questions have been
answered, that where material from the text has been used, it has been copied correctly, and that where an
answer to a question has been changed, the final answer is clear.
